name: Poppy Grower
ability: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
setup: Skip Minion info and Demon info on the first night; the Demon still learns 3 not-in-play bluffs.
interaction: None. After the Poppy Grower dies, that night the Minions learn the Demon and the Demon learns the Minions.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned on night 1, evil learns each other normally. Dying while drunk or poisoned triggers nothing.

jinxes.text: If Lil' Monsta & the Poppy Grower are alive, Minions wake one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Spy does not see the Grimoire.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Widow does not see the Grimoire.

rulings.text: Optional rule: if the Poppy Grower becomes drunk or poisoned, or leaves play, evil learns each other that night.
An evil Traveller still learns the Demon.
If the Drunk believes they are the Poppy Grower, evil learns each other on night 1 as normal and the death triggers nothing.
Night order numbers are from bra1n/townsquare src/roles.json (develop branch), not the botc-release list.
